$comment: Sanitized representative of the 1,000-record live netstats export supplied 9 October 2026. Exact observed data keys and JSON types; identifiers, addresses and values are synthetic. All records have eth0 with gw/tx/rx/ip/dns/mask and wwan with those fields plus driver/mtu. Counters and mtu are strings; timespan is an integer. No apipa, fail_count or extra interface in this export; older valid fixtures retain coverage for these optional fields.
